images.name: mac-confirm
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a pixel-sharp high-fidelity native macOS UI DESIGN MOCKUP, not a website, not a photograph of a device. Single straight-on desktop window at 1440x960 aspect ratio. This is the new RawLab batch export confirmation window. Image 1 is an established RawLab screenshot REFERENCE ONLY for neutral charcoal palette, native small system typography, yellow functional accent, square photo imagery. Do not reproduce the old editor layout or its enormous canvas: this is a focused export window.
Layout: compact macOS titlebar with traffic light controls and title "批量导出". Continuous charcoal surfaces with subtle separators, not nested cards, no gradients. Main body split 64% left / 36% right. Left header "待导出照片" with "已选 6 张" and small plus icon. Below an organized native list of SIX rows each with checked yellow checkbox, photographic thumbnail of distinct travel scenes (mountain, street, temple, park, bridge, coast), filename respectively "DSC06251.ARW", "DSC06271.ARW", "DSC06377.ARW", "DSC06395.ARW", "DSC06667.ARW", "DSC06765.ARW", neutral secondary camera metadata, and small remove icon. Preserve plenty of room for filenames and controls. Right column: heading "调整来源"; a compact landscape travel photo thumbnail next to "DSC06251.ARW" and "Velvia · 100%". Flat key/value rows "曝光" "+0.35 EV", "白平衡" "拍摄时设置", "曝光基准" "标准显影"; disclosure "全部调整". A thin separator then heading "输出"; native segmented choice "JPEG" selected / "16-bit PNG"; row "尺寸" "原始分辨率"; row "保存到" "Pictures / RawLab" with folder chooser icon; row "重名文件" "自动添加序号". Bottom fixed full-width footer with one unobtrusive line "仅用于本次导出，保留各照片原有调整", then right-aligned neutral button "取消" and yellow primary button "导出 6 张". Buttons 6px corners, restrained native sizes. No fake success, no progress. Chinese text must be accurate, legible, no overlapping labels. Use system line icons, visible photographic content, quiet technical product UI. No annotations outside window, no marketing, no dashboard metrics.

edits.prompt: Edit this RawLab macOS batch export confirmation UI with two precise corrections in the bottom-right "输出" section only. Preserve all other pixels, source photos, six filenames, six checkboxes, count, title, layout, typography and controls. 1) In row "尺寸", replace the rounded dark dropdown field containing "原始分辨率" with PLAIN right-aligned light-gray text "原始分辨率" on the continuous background. REMOVE its up/down chevrons and REMOVE its field box. This is read-only information, not a control. 2) In row "重名文件", similarly replace its dropdown field with PLAIN right-aligned light-gray text "自动添加序号". REMOVE its chevrons and field box. Keep the "保存到" path field AND folder-picker icon, and keep JPEG / 16-bit PNG selector interactive. Do not introduce any new controls.

images.name: windows-result
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. A pixel-sharp high fidelity native Windows 11 WPF desktop app UI mockup for RawLab batch export RESULTS. Single straight-on window, landscape 1440x960 aspect, no perspective, no device, no other windows. Reference 1 supplies RawLab's existing neutral dark charcoal surfaces, yellow functional accent, restrained system typography and photographic content. Translate the window chrome to Windows: compact app title at upper left "RawLab · 批量导出", minimize maximize close at upper right. NOT macOS traffic lights. Continuous flat dark gray surfaces, thin separators, no gradients or floating cards.
Body top at 32px in: heading "导出完成" around 24px, below readable summary "成功 5 张 · 失败 1 张". A thin fully complete muted yellow progress line, not a giant percentage. Then a short flat horizontal strip with a small mountain thumbnail and text "调整来源  DSC06251.ARW" and "Velvia · 100% · +0.35 EV"; on its right folder icon and "Pictures / RawLab". This is provenance, not an editable source.
Below, native compact list/table with headers "照片", "状态", "操作". Exactly SIX evenly spaced photographic rows: mountain DSC06251.ARW successful, street DSC06271.ARW successful, temple DSC06377.ARW failed, park DSC06395.ARW successful, bridge DSC06667.ARW successful, coast DSC06765.ARW successful. Successful rows show a small subdued green check icon and "已导出", a reveal-file icon in actions. Failed row shows small warm red error icon "读取失败" and secondary line "无法读取 RAW 文件" with a compact "重试" action. Error row has slightly different neutral fill, not a colored border. Do not duplicate or garble filenames. Photographic thumbnails crisp, illustrative.
Bottom fixed footer has left text "JPEG · 原始分辨率" and right-aligned neutral "关闭", outlined folder-icon button "打开文件夹", and yellow primary "重试失败的 1 张". The task is finished: NO cancel button, NO running spinner. Clear readable Simplified Chinese system typography, generous control hit areas, accessible contrast. Native product density, not a marketing concept board. No extra features, no external annotations.

images.name: android-editor
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a crisp high fidelity Android phone APP SCREEN, portrait 1080x2400 ratio, edge-to-edge screenshot, no physical device, no surrounding poster, not multiple phones. Reference image is the existing RawLab iOS editor and supplies ONLY the neutral charcoal photographic canvas, yellow functional accents, circular outlined tool buttons and photo-first balance. Adapt top chrome and system bars to native Android, not iOS.
Screen structure from top: Android status bar 9:41 and system icons. Compact toolbar "RawLab" with back arrow at left, comparison icon, export icon and three-dot menu at right. Immediately below a large natural landscape photograph of a green coastal mountain and waterfall, sharp actual photography occupying about 47% screen height, fit inside workspace without a card border. Subtle filename bottom-left overlay "DSC06251.ARW". Dark space around photo is functional fit background, not decoration.
Bottom adjustment surface integrated flat into screen: a header row "Velvia · 100%" on left and small gray check with "调整已保存" on right, visible without covering photograph. Next a horizontally scrollable peer tool strip of stable circular line icons with captions "胶片", "强度", "曝光", "高光", "阴影", "对比度"; the trailing tool partially visible indicates scrolling. Select "高光" with restrained yellow icon and signed adjustment arc, inactive tools gray. No second row of tools. Below divider, focused editor header "高光" left, "+25%" right in monospaced digits; full-width native slider with small center-zero marker and yellow thumb at 62.5%, subdued labels "-100", "0", "+100". Below slider a compact circular reset icon at right. All visible UI Chinese text correct and non-overlapping. Safe bottom system gesture area. No 'save' button; automatic saved status only. No separate film tab, no right sidebar, no informational tutorial text. Android control hit targets at least 48 logical px, comfortable whitespace, high contrast small system labels. No redesign of the established identity.

edits.prompt: Edit this RawLab Android UI mockup with ONE precise correction only. Preserve every text label, photo, layout, colors, icons, dimensions and all other details exactly. In the bottom "高光" slider showing "+25%": the neutral gray slider spans -100 on the left to +100 on the right, with zero tick at the midpoint. The knob is correctly to the right of zero. CHANGE THE YELLOW TRACK FILL: yellow must appear ONLY on the short segment between the zero midpoint tick and the current knob. The track left of zero is gray. The track right of the knob all the way to +100 is also gray. Keep the knob yellow at its existing position. Do not highlight the right-hand remainder. No other changes.

Existing screenshot reference carries only the app's charcoal dark neutrals, yellow functional accents, circular adjustment tool row, photo-first canvas and system fonts; DO NOT copy the reference's film chooser, replace it with white-balance controls.

images.name: ios-confirm
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity native iOS RawLab BATCH EXPORT CONFIRMATION SCREEN, a single straight-on portrait app viewport 1080x2400 ratio. No phone hardware frame, no poster, no multiple screens. Reference is the current RawLab mobile editor: inherit neutral charcoal surfaces, system font, restrained yellow accent. This screen is a native navigation page, not editor, no large canvas and no slider dock.
Native iOS status bar 9:41 and safe area. Navigation bar: left chevron "返回", centered "批量导出", no duplicate export button top right.
First flat section heading "调整来源"; horizontal row with landscape waterfall thumbnail about 88 logical points wide, text "DSC06251.ARW" and "Velvia · 100%". Key/value rows with subtle separators: "曝光" "+0.35 EV"; "白平衡" "拍摄时设置"; "全部调整" right chevron.
Second flat section header "目标照片" with right action "更改". A single horizontal strip of four small square photographic thumbnails (waterfall, mountain, street, temple) with the last having subtle overlay "+2". Under strip compact "已选 6 张 RAW".
Third flat section heading "输出"; rows "格式" "JPEG", "尺寸" "原始分辨率", "保存到" "照片图库". These values are plain text, NOT dropdowns, NO chevrons: they are fixed for iOS first release. No 16-bit PNG, no folder chooser.
At bottom fixed footer above home indicator with small two-line neutral note "仅用于本次导出" and "保留各照片原有调整". A full-width restrained yellow 8px-radius primary button "导出 6 张" with black bold readable text. Body content scrolls if needed; footer not overlaying last row. All sections use continuous surfaces and hairline separators, never cards in cards. Native system font sizes, normal 17pt body equivalent, compact 20pt heading, not large display typography. 44pt tap targets, exact Simplified Chinese, alignment, no clipped labels, no gradients, no tutorial copy, no progress or result in this confirmation state.

edits.prompt: Edit this RawLab iOS batch-export confirmation mockup with ONE exact text correction only. The first character must be 曝, the second 光. Preserve every other pixel as closely as possible: all layout, images, other Chinese text, values, source photo, buttons and colors. Do not add or remove controls.

Precise UI text replacement edit. In this iPhone screenshot, DELETE the two-character label at x=40,y=505 approximately (the left label on the row whose right value is "+0.35 EV"). Replace that entire label with the FOUR Chinese characters "曝光补偿" using the same white system font, left aligned in that row. Exact required text: 曝 光 补 偿 (without spaces). The old label must not remain. This row identifies exposure compensation, so it MUST say "曝光补偿", not "调光". The longer four-character label is intentional. Preserve the +0.35 EV value, every other label, photograph, layout, button and spacing. Do not regenerate the rest of the UI.
